title: astragalus monspessulanus var. praecox
intro: Astragalus monspessulanus var. praecox, commonly known as Early Goat's-thorn or Précoce, is a variety of Astragalus monspessulanus, a type of flowering plant in the legume family. This plant is traditionally used to support immune function, improve cardiovascular health, and alleviate symptoms of respiratory infections. The therapeutic actions of Astragalus monspessulanus var. praecox include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and immunomodulatory effects, which contribute to its health benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and polyphenols, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
